picks.name: Milano Ribbed Shirt Collar Cardigan, olive
picks.why: Your office and date-night outfits still have no knit or cardigan. This is a regular-fit cardigan in a dense Milano rib that holds its shape without adding bulk, with a neat shirt collar. Wear it buttoned over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or open over a tee with the 502s.

picks.name: Short Sleeve T-Shirt, charcoal
picks.why: A plain tee is still the gap in three of your five outfits. Regular fit in 200g organic cotton, made in the UK by the same people as your raglan sweats, with no branding. Layer it under the navy Parachute jacket or the Ashby with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: Fleece Full-Zip Jacket, navy
picks.why: A warm winter mid-layer for photography walks and lounging at home. Classic regular-fit fleece with a stand collar, plain navy and close enough to sit under the Ashby or the field jacket. Wear it with the navy relaxed chinos and Vans Era.
